quote: He then expressed the view that we should consider the use of tactical atomic weapons on the Kaesong area, which provided a good target for this type of weapon.
notes: Presidential suggestion in NSC; no decision. Kaesong was the communist-held armistice-talks area south of the 38th parallel.

source_doc: FRUS 1952-54 vol. XV Korea, doc. 807: Memorandum by the JCS to the Secretary of Defense, "U.S. Courses of Action in Korea" (NSC 170 series), 27 Nov 1953, Appendix B; https://history.state.gov/historicaldocuments/frus1952-54v15p2/d807
source_page: FRUS p.1629 (Appendix B, para 7); course of action p.1627
quote: Provision for attacks on targets in the Dairen-Port Arthur area will be included in the plans. Specific approval by the Joint Chiefs of Staff will be required prior to implementation of such attacks.
notes: Planning assumption for the JCS-recommended course: "Employing atomic weapons, conduct large-scale air operations against targets in China, Manchuria and Korea" if the Communists renewed the war. NSC 170/1 (Dec 1953) adopted a version; on 3 Dec Radford said the JCS had not yet laid out their target system (doc. 811). Only this area is named; Bowie (doc. 810, p.1635) discusses "U.S. attacks on Port Arthur and Dairen" as the most dangerous option. Provenance plan: JCS planning guidance, not an approved target annex.
